Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Quicksilver wrote:
> Does Faceless Night's tapping affect kick in at the end of the
> action or immediately after the methuselah states that he is
> not blocking.

The latter. I've been saying "when the action resolves" - but that
answer isn't precise enough (for cases like: "I don't block",
"I'll boost with conditioning", "then I'll Deflect").

The would-be blocker is, in fact, tapped as soon as you declare that
you are not blocking. [RTR 950622]
